    setK(C.snd[d.id]);const kn=$('#knob');let drag=false;const upd=e=>{const b=kn.getBoundingClientRect();let a=Math.atan2(e.clientY-(b.top+b.height/2),e.clientX-(b.left+b.width/2))*180/Math.PI;a=(a-135+720)%360;if(a>270)a=a>315?0:270;C.snd[d.id]=Math.round(a/270*100)/10;setK(C.snd[d.id])};
    const fin=()=>{commit();const t=$$('.tape')[cur];$('.v',t).textContent=C.snd[d.id].toFixed(1)};

    kn.onkeydown=e=>{const s={ArrowLeft:-.5,ArrowDown:-.5,ArrowRight:.5,ArrowUp:.5}[e.key];if(s==null)return;e.preventDefault();C.snd[d.id]=clamp((C.snd[d.id]||0)+s,0,10);setK(C.snd[d.id]);fin()};
    $('#go').onclick=next;
  };draw();
}

/* =============== 08 · 档案 + 提交 =============== */
function rFile(el){
  const wq=Q('walk_unease'),walk=wq.trials.map((_,k)=>tval('walk_unease',k)||0),wAvg=walk.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/walk.length/100;
  const thr=(A.threshold_level||0)/100,sAvg=Object.values(C.snd).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/Math.max(1,Object.keys(C.snd).length)/10;
  const dAvg=Object.values(C.dist).reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/Math.max(1,Object.keys(C.dist).length),rd=SCEN.map(s=>C.routes[s.id]).filter(r=>r&&r.done),dark=rd.reduce((a,b)=>a+b.dark,0)/Math.max(1,rd.length);
  const idx=Math.round(clamp(.28*thr+.24*wAvg*1.4+.18*sAvg+.15*clamp(dAvg/12)+.15*(1-dark))*100);

  const dq=Q('stranger_distance');

  <div class="dossier"><div class="panel"><div class="ph">照明阈值</div><div class="mono" style="font-size:44px;font-weight:800;color:var(--cyan)">${A.threshold_level??'—'}<small style="font-size:15px"> / 100</small></div><p style="font-size:12px;color:var(--muted)">低于此相对亮度时，你倾向于绕开街道。</p></div>
    <div class="panel"><div class="ph">夜行 · 各段平均不安</div>${wq.trials.map((t,k)=>`<div class="zb"><img src="${esc(t.media[0].url)}" alt="第 ${k+1} 段"><div class="b"><i style="width:${walk[k]}%"></i></div><b class="mono">${walk[k]}</b></div>`).join('')}</div>
    <div class="panel"><div class="ph">距离 · 个人安全边界</div>${dq.dimensions.map(d=>{const v=C.dist[d.id];if(v==null)return'';const p=prox(v);return`<div class="drow"><span style="font-size:12px">${esc(d.label)}</span><div class="b"><i style="width:${Math.min(100,v/20*100)}%;background:${p[3]}"></i></div><b class="mono">${v.toFixed(1)}m</b></div>`}).join('')}</div>
    <div class="panel"><div class="ph">声音 · 不安排名</div>${Q('sound_unease').dimensions.slice().sort((a,b)=>(C.snd[b.id]||0)-(C.snd[a.id]||0)).map(d=>`<div class="drow" style="grid-template-columns:150px 1fr 40px"><span style="font-size:12px">${SOUNDS[d.id].ic} ${esc(d.label)}</span><div class="b"><i style="width:${(C.snd[d.id]||0)*10}%;background:hsl(${lerp(150,350,(C.snd[d.id]||0)/10)},90%,62%)"></i></div><b class="mono">${(C.snd[d.id]||0).toFixed(1)}</b></div>`).join('')}</div>
    <div class="panel w"><div class="ph">归途 · 黑暗暴露与绕行</div>${SCEN.map(s=>{const r=C.routes[s.id]||{};return`<div class="drow" style="grid-template-columns:180px 1fr 130px"><span style="font-size:12px">${s.t}</span><div class="b"><i style="width:${(r.dark||0)*100}%;background:#ff4d6d"></i></div><span class="mono" style="font-size:12px">暗 ${Math.round((r.dark||0)*100)}% · ${r.detour?r.detour+'×':'—'}</span></div>`}).join('')}</div></div>
  <div class="panel" style="margin-top:14px;text-align:center"><p class="lead" style="margin:0 auto 12px">确认无误后提交。提交后数据将进入研究数据库。</p><button class="btn btn-amber" id="submit" style="min-height:54px;padding:0 34px">提交答卷 ✦</button><div id="miss"></div></div></div>`;
